_meta.tax_rate_default: state the assumed tax rate in the question; the grader defaults to 40% otherwise

schema.question: string
schema.answerKey: string — the worked solution / ground truth

questions.question: A company delivers $25 worth of product to a customer for a price of $100, but the customer has not yet paid. Walk through the three statements at delivery, then when the $100 is collected. Assume a 40% tax rate.
questions.answerKey: At delivery: IS — Revenue +100, COGS +25, Pre-tax +75, Net income +45. CFS — Net income +45, less AR increase 100, CFO -55, net change in cash -55. BS — Cash -55, AR +100, Inventory -25; Retained earnings +45 (assets +20 = L+E +20 via RE +45 and cash already in). When collected: IS no change; CFS cash +100 (AR decrease), CFO +100; BS cash +100, AR -100, balances.
